overviewParagraphs: Laguna Golf Phuket offers the quintessential resort golf experience — a beautifully conditioned layout winding through the 1,000-acre Laguna Phuket estate, where fairways thread between coconut palm groves, over serene lagoons, and past the manicured gardens that connect the estate's world-class hotels. It is a course where the natural beauty of the setting is the primary attraction.

The layout is accessible to all levels of golfer while still providing genuine scoring challenge from the back tees. The signature island green finishes create memorable moments on multiple holes, the greens are consistently true and well-paced, and the support infrastructure — clubhouse, caddies, dining — matches the estate's five-star resort standards.

For discerning golfers staying within the Laguna Phuket estate at Bang Tao or travelling for a combined beach and golf holiday, AGS recommends Laguna Golf as an outstanding round-start for any Phuket program — comfortable enough to ease into the trip, beautiful enough to set an excellent tone.

curatorBriefHtml: Laguna Golf Phuket (extensively redesigned in 2014 by Paul Jansen inside the prestigious Bang Tao / Laguna Phuket resort enclave) is Phuket’s most seamless, walkable luxury resort course. Measuring 6,606 yards (Par 71), the layout winds gently around tranquil freshwater lagoons, coconut groves, and wide, mounded fairways — rewarding thoughtful iron placement into subtly undulating greens without punishing resort golfers unfairly.

Having played Laguna Golf Phuket and stayed at Banyan Tree Phuket personally, the convenience is unbeatable: you can walk or shuttle 3 minutes from your private pool villa straight to the first tee, play a breezy 4-hour morning round, and be poolside by noon.
Laguna Golf Phuket makes the ideal Day 1 warm-up round on a Phuket golf week before stepping up to the dramatic canyons of Red Mountain, Blue Canyon, and Aquella.

scorecard.verdict: Redesigned by Paul Jansen, Laguna Golf Phuket is an elegant, walkable resort course winding through scenic waterways and coconut groves inside the acclaimed Laguna Phuket destination.

faqs.q: How close is Laguna Golf Phuket to Banyan Tree Phuket and Bang Tao resorts?
faqs.a: Laguna Golf Phuket sits right inside the Laguna Phuket estate — just 2 to 5 minutes by resort shuttle from Banyan Tree Phuket, Angsana, and Dusit Thani, and 25 minutes from Phuket International Airport (HKT).

faqs.q: How did the 2014 Paul Jansen redesign improve Laguna Golf Phuket?
faqs.a: Jansen completely rebuilt every green complex, added strategic low-profile bunkering and sculpted run-off areas, and opened up scenic lagoon sightlines — transforming it into a modern, fun, impeccably conditioned Par 71 resort track.

faqs.q: Is Laguna Golf Phuket good for mixed-handicap couples and holiday groups?
faqs.a: Yes — it is Phuket’s friendliest luxury championship course, pairing generous tee landing zones with genuinely interesting green-side short-game choices.

faqs.q: When is the best season to play Laguna Golf Phuket?
faqs.a: November through April is Phuket’s dry high season with sunny tropical weather and fast drainage.
